newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD maintained as buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said in a report it has maintained its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce.
-- The bank cited CVRD's upcoming privatization, saying the selloff was likely to begin in 1997's first quarter despite minor delays and be completed by the end of next year.
-- It also said the government is likely to set a base price of over $10 billion. The bank has valued CVRD at $10.5 billion.
-- "Despite minor delays, CVRD's privatization is largely on schedule," the report said.
-- It added that the active formation of consortia by investors interested in bidding on the firm "bodes well for CVRD's stock price."
-- CVRD is the world's largest iron ore producer with other mining, rail and port interests.
-- CVRD blue-chip preferred was off 0.91 percent at 20.61 reais while its voting common was up 0.75 percent at 27 reais at 1423 local/1623 GMT on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
